captions.detailed: This 3D model features a professional widescreen computer monitor mounted on a heavy, rectangular pedestal stand. The entire assembly is finished in a uniform matte black color. The display panel connects to the upper stand head via a tilt bracket, while the base of the stand includes a cylindrical swivel collar. A tiny cylindrical joystick projects from the lower rear edge of the display panel for menu navigation.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a professional computer monitor with a wide screen, a heavy pedestal stand, and a rear swivel collar. Ensure the model includes a small power joystick on the lower rear of the panel, and define revolute joints for the vertical swivel collar, the horizontal tilt bracket, and the joystick pivot.
captions.factory: The object is constructed using four main parts: the base, the stand column, the display panel, and the rear joystick. The base is built by combining a rounded rectangular box with a vertical cylinder representing the swivel collar. The stand column is modeled as a box that is filleted and joined with a horizontal cylinder representing the upper tilt hinge. The display panel is made using a thin, filleted box with a recessed screen pocket. The joystick is constructed from a small cylinder attached to a spherical joint. These parts are connected using three revolute joints: one for the vertical swivel at the base, one for the horizontal tilt at the stand head, and one for the joystick pivot.
